title: Berberine nanostructures attenuate ss-catenin, a key component of epithelial mesenchymal transition in lung adenocarcinoma.
authors: Malyla, Vamshikrishna; De Rubis, Gabriele; Paudel, Keshav Raj; Chellappan, Dinesh Kumar; Hansbro, Nicole G; Hansbro, Philip M; Dua, Kamal
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱纳米颗粒抑制肺癌中β-catenin通路，虽含分子模拟但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Lung cancer (LC) is the leading cause of cancer-related deaths globally. It accounts for more than 1.9 million cases each year due to its complex and poorly understood molecular mechanisms that result in unregulated cell proliferation and metastasis. beta-Catenin is a developmentally active protein that controls cell proliferation, metastasis, polarity and cell fate during homeostasis and aids in cancer progression via epithelial-mesenchymal transition. Therefore, inhibition of the beta-catenin pathway could attenuate the progression of LC. Berberine, an isoquinoline alkaloid which is known for its anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory properties, demonstrates poor solubility and bioavailability. In our study, we have encapsulated berberine into liquid crystalline nanoparticles to improve its physiochemical functions and studied if these nanoparticles target the beta-catenin pathway to inhibit the human lung adenocarcinoma cell line (A549) at both gene and protein levels. We observed for the first time that berberine liquid crystalline nanoparticles at 5 microM significantly attenuate the expression of the beta-catenin gene and protein. The interaction between berberine and beta-catenin was further validated by molecular simulation studies. Targeting beta-catenin with berberine nanoparticles represents a promising strategy for the management of lung cancer progression.
abstract_zh: 肺癌（LC）是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因。由于其复杂且尚未完全阐明的分子机制导致细胞增殖和转移失控，每年新增病例超过190万例。β-连环蛋白（beta-Catenin）是一种发育活跃的蛋白质，在稳态期间控制细胞增殖、转移、极性和细胞命运，并通过上皮-间质转化促进癌症进展。因此，抑制β-连环蛋白通路可能减弱肺癌的进展。小檗碱（Berberine）是一种异喹啉生物碱，以其抗癌和抗炎特性而闻名，但其溶解性和生物利用度较差。在本研究中，我们将小檗碱封装到液晶纳米颗粒中，以改善其理化功能，并研究了这些纳米颗粒是否靶向β-连环蛋白通路，在基因和蛋白质水平上抑制人肺腺癌细胞系（A549）。我们首次观察到，5微摩尔的小檗碱液晶纳米颗粒显著减弱了β-连环蛋白基因和蛋白质的表达。小檗碱与β-连环蛋白之间的相互作用通过分子模拟研究进一步验证。用小檗碱纳米颗粒靶向β-连环蛋白代表了一种管理肺癌进展的有前景的策略。
